scope: No-cache training forward in real arithmetic, with all independent weights, exact source normalization placement and explicit first-position attention zero.
rms_epsilon: dtype machine epsilon; 2^-23 for float32 and 2^-52 for float64
generalizations: Arbitrary finite context and architecture dimensions, subject to the actual head reshape constraints.
Arbitrary per-layer, per-position, per-pair angle tables; source grid and disabled RoPE are special cases.
excluded: Global differentiability at the XSA clipping boundary
source_execution_conditions: Use source hidden size, source RoPE phases/enable flags and positions within configured block_size. Arbitrary phases, hidden sizes and longer directly supplied phase tables are explicit mathematical generalizations.
